if a project supports Valgrind, it requires an add_test_setup with Valgrind. 

However, when I added this, the CI started failing due to conflicts between ASAN and Valgrind. 

I verified in the build scripts that ASAN and Valgrind run sequentially first ASAN, then Valgrind so they are not  supposed to run concurrently but was not able to debug why it was happening.

For now, I have removed the Valgrind setup and will reintroduce Valgrind support later.
